theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

top_news.title: Asian Bonds Rise After Treasury Rally, Stocks Fall: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian bonds rose and Treasuries held gains that pulled yields back from multi-decade highs, as traders looked past higher oil prices and their inflationary impact. Regional stocks edged lower.

top_news.title: Anthropic Said to Target Mega-IPO Before Thanksgiving Holiday
top_news.summary: Anthropic PBC is seeking to go public as soon as the middle of November, according to people familiar with the matter, after the artificial intelligence model maker pushed back plans to list. Bloomberg's Anthony Stephens has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Nvidia-Backed Firmus Eyes $30 Billion Valuation in Australia IPO
top_news.summary: Data center operator Firmus Grid Ltd. is seeking a A$43.7 billion ($30.3 billion) valuation in its Australian initial public offering this month, according to terms of the deal seen by Bloomberg.

top_news.title: Gold Steadies as Easing US Bond Yields Reduce Rate-Hike Bets
top_news.summary: Gold held a modest gain as US bond yields softened and Federal Reserve officials signaled they needed more time to weigh their next move on interest rates, even as a possible escalation in the Middle East kept energy costs elevated.

top_news.title: What Do Entertainment Industry Leaders Look for in a Pitch?
top_news.summary: Entertainment industry leaders share what they look for in order to greenlight a pitch today on the sidelines of the Bloomberg Screentime event in Los Angeles. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Bloomberg Screentime: AI, Streaming Wars and Deals
top_news.summary:
The impact AI will have on entertainment, the next phase of the streaming wars and the deals reshaping the industry. Lucas Shaw shares the biggest moments you need to know about from the Bloomberg Screentime event in Los Angeles. 

Original filename: 10.1.26_Screentime_Wrap_1.mp4 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: NBCUniversal's Donna Langley on Film, TV and Streaming
top_news.summary: NBCUniversal Entertainment Chairman, Donna Langley discusses the company’s film and television strategy and her plans to stand out in a competitive streaming landscape with Bloomberg’s Lucas Shaw at Bloomberg Screentime 2026 in Los Angeles. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Australia-US Bond Yield Gap Nears Zero as Policy Paths Diverge
top_news.summary: Australia’s benchmark bond yield looks poised to fall below its US counterpart for the first time in over a year, as expectations for monetary policy in the two economies diverge.

top_news.title: Paramount Dealmaker Says Warner Merger Is About Growth, Not Cuts
top_news.summary: Gerry Cardinale, the founder of the investment firm RedBird Capital Partners and one of the architects of Paramount Skydance Corp.’s pending acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc., said the performance of the combined companies will impress investors.

top_news.title: RedBird's Cardinale on Paramount Future & Investing
top_news.summary: RedBird Capital Partners Founder & Managing Partner, Gerry Cardinale discusses investment across sports, media and entertainment. Plus, the future of a Paramount Skydance, Warner Bros. Discovery combination with Bloomberg’s Lucas Shaw at Bloomberg Screentime 2026 in Los Angeles. (Source: Bloomberg)
